title: The school replicates: Meridian's instruments become operations on datavism.org
editorial_proposition: A standing reuse relation transcribed retroactively (2026-07-17): Meridian's conditions stand as an offer; datavism accepted by decision record and built a pipeline that automates the TRANSPORT of works while deliberately keeping their didactic TRANSLATION manual; fourteen works are synced; the practice was admitted to the ecology on 2026-07-17, superseding the pre-constitutional wing framing. The relation is open and running.

proposition_author.note: retroactive transcription commissioned by Frank (2026-07-17 [redacted 2026-10-05 under the privacy rule; wording private]); lean record — the nightly scribe appends from here

status.statusLine: open/standing, transformed — the automated mirror (ADR 003 Phase 2) that carried 22 synced works was withdrawn by Frank 2026-09-08 (datavism.org commit 7b9abb3, wording private): src/content/field-works/ and /field are removed, redirecting 301 to frankbueltge.de/field; the pipeline's own stated reason is that the mirror was a third address for a text that already stands canonically on frankbueltge.de/field and in the public field-research repo. Phase 1 (datavism's own hand-translated Command-Center operations, citing Meridian directly via derivedFrom) and Phase 3 (the atlas snapshot) are explicitly unaffected and remain live — the relation continues, the mirror does not; 22 remains the mirror's final count. The instrument-016 mirrored-page content-loss regression (evt-09) is moot with the mirror's removal, not repaired.
